portfolio: This is Calderwood's month at a glance: each borrower, and how its check is going.
late: First, the paperwork. One report is late, so the system has already chased it.
layout: One borrower changed its file layout. The AI matched the new columns itself.
rollforward: Next, the numbers. Last month's loans plus new ones should equal this month's.
gap: They don't. Some loans have gone missing from the borrower's file.
chargeoffs: And the borrower's two reports disagree on which loans were written off.
terms: The loan agreement changed in June. May is still checked against the old terms.
trigger: Now the warning signs. Late payments at one borrower are close to the limit.
whatif: One more bad month and the bank stops lending. The analyst can test that now.
leverage: Another borrower's debt looks fine, unless a guarantee counts. An expert decides.
collateral: And one car has been used to secure loans with two different borrowers.
triage: Everything found goes to one place. The AI suggests, the analyst decides.
noise: Small, harmless differences are set aside, with a reason, so they don't distract.
pack: Then the report to the bank. The AI writes it; every number comes from the checks.
approve: The analyst can't sign off their own work. A second analyst approves and sends it.
results: The result: every real problem found, and nothing harmless flagged.
